reply_text:
I found seven quotes from 2025. Three match claims you've already recorded. The others are either reporters' paraphrases or have a time frame that only comes from the interviewer's question. I found no new prediction in Lee's own words that clearly meets all four tests.

- **Already recorded (People's Daily English interview).** Lee reposted the interview himself on WeChat, and Sina republished that post on 2025-02-07. It contains three recorded claims word for word: AGI within ten years, AI creating ten times as many new jobs within five years, and Chinese AI-first apps reaching the world's top tier in 2025. I dated them by the post, not 2025-01-16. I didn't see the interview date, so please check that against your files.
- **Same post, one line not on your list.** Lee's own summary at the top says 2025 will be the first year of an explosion in AI-first apps. It is close to your "among best in 2025" file, so you'll need to decide whether it is the same claim.
- **Coverage only.**
  - At the Zhongguancun Forum (29 March), The Paper reports him saying the same thing about 2025. Those words are the reporter's paraphrase.
  - At TED AI San Francisco (October), a blogger reports him predicting 2026 as the year AI agents become "the fundamental unit of work." I never found Lee's own words for that.
- **Weak, with the date from the question.** In a Bloomberg interview (third-party transcript on a personal blog, posted 2025-11-19), the interviewer asks about "going into next year." Lee says he doesn't expect a "huge breakout change-the-world technology" from China. The time frame comes from the question, not from him.

**Gaps:** I used all six page openings and 7 of the 12 searches. The SCMP report on his September UBS summit talk (via Yahoo) cut off after its first sentence. The Pandaily page on his December conference talk showed only metadata. I didn't open the sources behind your 2025-10-02 and 2025-10-30 files, so I couldn't confirm those.
